source.title: Project Diablo 2 Item Affixes
source.policy: DOCUMENTED requires a governed claim and a materialized exact occurrence match on table, sourceRow, fingerprint, name, ordered properties and ordered itemTypes. Unproved differences remain TABLE_ONLY; unrelated rows remain UNMAPPED.

claims.summary: The Removed Affixes table explicitly lists this former occurrence as removed.
Season 3 removed ordinary skill-charge affixes while retaining governed curse and teleport exceptions.
Season 7 capped the listed low-level affix families forty levels after their first availability.
Season 7 added three governed cast-on-casting staff tiers and three on-striking weapon tiers for seven elemental skills.
Season 9 increased elemental-damage prefix and suffix values, with a smaller cold adjustment.
Season 9 added Virulent and the level-70 Ashes, Maelstrom, Hypothermia and Contagion elemental tiers.
Season 9 added three Amplify Damage and Lower Resist tiers for both casting and striking triggers.
Season 10 added the governed fire, cold, lightning and poison resistance-piercing affix tiers.
Season 11 increased the frequency of enhanced-defense prefixes.
Season 11 doubled the values of replenish-life affixes.
Season 12 removed chance-to-flee prefixes from staves, orbs and wands.
Season 12 removed flat elemental-damage affixes from staves, orbs and wands.
Season 12 removed life- and mana-leech affixes from orbs and wands.
Season 12 removed reduced-requirements affixes from wands.
Season 12 removed repair-durability affixes from orbs and wands.
Season 12 removed on-hit and on-attack skill affixes from orbs and wands.
Season 12 removed the Teleport charge occurrence from orbs.
Season 13 increased life- and mana-after-kill values and documents their governed item-type additions.
Season 13 added the governed physical-damage-reduction percentage tiers for helmets, armor and shields.
Season 13 added helmet crushing-blow and deadly-strike prefix tiers up to 20 percent.
Season 13 added glove crushing-blow and deadly-strike prefix tiers up to 10 percent.
Season 13 added the governed increased-block and faster-block glove suffix tiers.
Season 13 added the documented Barbarian combat and Druid shapeshifting skill-tab tiers to gloves.
Season 13 raised staff Sorceress-skill prefixes from +1/+2 to +2/+4.
Season 13 fixed and extended the 10-30 percent enhanced-damage helmet prefix tiers.
Season 13 disabled the +1 to 2-6 fire-damage glove affix occurrence.
Season 13 enabled the governed three- and four-socket affix tiers on rare equipment.
The compilation documents the level-75 301-400 percent Visceral weapon prefix and its eligible families.
The governed highest-level list identifies the Embattled and Rampaging enhanced-damage armor occurrences.
The compilation documents the Guardianship physical-damage-reduction armor and shield occurrence.
The compilation documents the level-81 Performance jewelry and headgear occurrence.
Season 3 lowered the governed Lamprey and Vampire affix and required levels.
The Highest-Level Affixes section explicitly lists this occurrence.
